content: For individuals with severe complications arising from type 1 diabetes, therapeutic options include pancreas or islet cell transplantation. However, these procedures necessitate lifelong immunosuppressive therapy to prevent graft rejection. The 2021 joint report by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) and the European Association for the Study of Diabetes (EASD) offers detailed guidance on the management of type 1 diabetes and outlines specific criteria for the consideration of beta-cell replacement therapy.
